YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Masinloc, Candelaria, Santa Cruz), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Bamban, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Mayantoc, Moncada, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia), Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Apalit, Bacolor, San Fernando, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Mexico, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Porac, Santa Rita), Bulacan(Bustos, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, Santa Maria), Batangas(Tanauan, Talisay, Mabini, Bauan, San Luis, Taal, San Nicolas, Santa Teresita, Laurel, Agoncillo, Lemery, Calaca, Tuy, Balayan, Lian, Calatagan, Nasugbu, Santo Tomas, Malvar, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Alitagtag, Cuenca, Lipa, San Jose, San Pascual), Laguna(Cabuyao, Calamba, Binan, Santa Rosa, San Pedro, Los Banos, Alaminos, Mabitac, Siniloan, Pangil, Famy, Santa Maria, Paete, Kalayaan, Pakil, Lumban, Santa Cruz, Pila, Victoria, Calauan, Bay) and Nueva Ecija(Guimba, Talugtug, Cuyapo, Nampicuan, Lupao, Munoz).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bulacan(San Miguel, San Ildefonso, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Angat, Norzagaray, San Rafael), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba), Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, San Antonio, Gapan, General Tinio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Bongabon, Cabanatuan, Carranglan, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Jaen, Laur, Licab, Llanera, Palayan, Pantabangan, Penaranda, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Talavera, Zaragoza), Quezon(General Nakar, Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Patnanungan, Real, Infanta, Pagbilao, Tayabas, Mauban, Sampaloc, Lucban, Lucena, Atimonan, Sariaya, Tiaong, Candelaria, San Antonio, Dolores), Laguna(Cavinti, Liliw, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Rizal, San Pablo) and Batangas(Batangas City, Ibaan, Lobo, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Juan, Taysan, Tingloy) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
